headline: Relink your offline files and Trace+ puts them back in their bins for you.
notes: Files in _OFFLINE go back to the bin they came from once you relink them in Premiere. On by default – Settings › Put relinked files back automatically. Only files Trace+ saw offline are moved, so anything you already keep in _OFFLINE stays put
One _OFFLINE bin for every offline file, from the Offline chip or the Handover check. Only offline files go in
The Handover check now counts offline Dynamic Link items, so it agrees with the Offline chip
Copy report sits on one line and shows a green tick for 2 seconds once it has copied
The Handover report shows file paths without Premiere's extra slashes
Move's tooltip tells project items from ticked files, and says what was left out and why
In Filters, "On the panel" is now Panel and "How rows are drawn" is now Display
